# Sona 1.9.0 is here! 🎉

This is our biggest update yet: a fresh Material 3 Expressive look throughout, a guided setup that can bring your whole library back from a backup, a redesigned library and mini player, and a browser built into Downloads. Here's what's new.

## ✨ What's new

- **A whole new look.** Sona moves to Material 3 Expressive: livelier motion, rounded icons, inset list rows, pill-shaped tabs, and redesigned settings with clearer switches, sliders and dialogs.
- **A welcoming first launch.** A new setup walks you through permissions, your theme, your media folders and updates. Sona's mark flies from the launch screen into the library as everything else arrives.
- **Restore just what you want.** During setup, pick a backup from Google Drive or a file and choose what comes back: settings, playlists, favorites, history, and exactly which songs and videos, with the download size shown against the space left on your phone. Your library comes back first, and the media downloads after it.
- **A redesigned library.** A new header with Sona's mark, shortcuts and tabs under it, a list header showing each tab's count and sort, and a tab editor of its own. Track rows now show the artist and duration.
- **Your mini player, your way.** Choose the button beside play in Appearance settings: skip to next, repeat, shuffle or favorite. Swiping the mini player feels more natural, with an indicator showing which way it skips and when letting go will skip.
- **Tap the cover for lyrics.** Tapping the artwork in the player opens the lyrics. You can also hide the lyrics preview line under the title.
- **Easier queue editing.** Long-press a song in the queue to move it. There's no handle to catch by mistake.
- **A browser in Downloads.** Browse with tabs and bookmarks, and download whatever you find there.
- **Share to Sona.** Links shared from other apps open straight in Downloads.
- **More download settings.** Downloads settings are split into clear pages, with new options: proxy, rate limit, IPv4, concurrent fragments, a custom user agent, thumbnails, incognito mode, cookie profiles and more.
- **Smarter transcription.** Your Supadata or Groq key is checked before it's saved, and you can see how many credits or requests each service has left.
- **Video details.** A video keeps its upload date, views and likes from when it was downloaded, shown in the player's new About panel.
- **Copy subtitles.** Long-press a subtitle track in the video player to copy its text.
- **Video player extras.** An optional thin progress line while the controls are hidden, and a choice of font for subtitles, including one of your own.
- **Rename from the library.** Rename a playlist, or a track's file, from its options.
- **Automatic updates.** New versions download in the background and install while you're not using Sona, on Wi‑Fi unless you allow mobile data.
- **One storage permission.** Sona now asks for a single permission that covers all your files, and explains why first.
- **Backups know their device.** Each backup shows the phone it was made on.
- **Opens in your colours.** Sona remembers the colour from your last cover, so it opens looking just as you left it.

## 🐛 Fixes

- An automatic backup now shows on the Backup screen, where you can pause or stop it. The first one starts a week after you turn it on, not right after setup.
- Where you left your videos is picked up right after a restore.
- A restored Favorites playlist gets its cover back.
- Floating buttons step aside at the end of a list, so they never cover your last rows.
- Video covers use a clear frame, not a black opening one.
- The player's top buttons no longer crowd the status bar or a notch.
- Faster, more reliable file downloads that resume where they stopped.
- The launch screen no longer flickers away on a busy start.

Thanks for using Sona. Enjoy the update! 💙
